NDT training in Rochester, NY: how it works

Short answer: In Rochester, New York, NDT theory is studied online at your own pace with an ASNT NDT Level III answering questions, practised in a browser simulator, and finished with a hands-on practical at your employer's own facility. Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Rochester. Under ASNT SNT-TC-1A the employer issues certification; a course on its own cannot. We reply within one business day.

This page covers Rochester in western New York, on the south shore of Lake Ontario, not Rochester, Minnesota. The city built its name on cameras, film and optics, and that heritage still shapes the work: gear-making, precision machining, optical and defense electronics manufacturing sit alongside a nuclear plant on the lake shore, a regional electric and gas utility, freight rail and the bridges and lift spans of the Genesee Valley. Much of what is made here is small, exact and expensive, so the inspection that goes with it rewards care more than speed.

People who type "ndt training Rochester NY" usually fall into one of four groups: machinists who want to move into the quality lab, welders who want inspection credentials, people changing careers after work in the imaging or manufacturing sector, and employers who need technicians qualified to satisfy a customer or a utility. The rest of this page answers each of them. For statewide context see NDT training in New York, and for the national picture NDT training in the USA.

How to get NDT certified in Rochester: the SNT-TC-1A path

  1. Identify the written practice that will govern you. An employer writes it on the basis of ASNT SNT-TC-1A and sets out training, experience, examinations, vision and recertification for each method and level. Job seekers can start studying before they are hired.
  2. Finish the formal training hours. Online theory counts toward them. Recommended hours by method and level are in the training-requirements matrix.
  3. Build supervised experience. Hours performing the method under a certified Level II or III are logged and countersigned; this is normally the longest stage.
  4. Sit the general examination, a written test of method theory and terminology.
  5. Sit the specific examination, based on the employer's own procedures, equipment and acceptance criteria.
  6. Sit the practical examination, finding and evaluating known flaws in real specimens under a Level III's grading.
  7. Pass the vision checks: near vision every year and color contrast, as the written practice specifies.
  8. Be certified by the employer, with the signed certificate kept alongside your training and experience file.
  9. Renew at the interval in the written practice, typically five years.

Use the SNT-TC-1A eligibility checker to see which level your current hours reach. If you want a credential that is yours rather than your employer's, ASNT central certification (ASNT 9712 for Level I and II, and the ASNT NDT Level III examinations) is the other route, and Atlantis prepares candidates for it.

Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 NDT courses for Rochester technicians

MethodWhat the course coversWhere it is used around Rochester
VTVisual acuity, illumination, magnification, gauges and acceptance criteriaMachined parts, weldments, structural steel, bridge and canal structures
PTVisible and fluorescent penetrants, removal methods, developers, evaluationAluminum and stainless housings, precision non-magnetic parts, castings
MTCircular and longitudinal magnetization, fluorescent wet method, field checksGears, shafts and forgings, heat-treated steel parts, lifting equipment
UTCalibration, contact and immersion basics, thickness and angle-beam weld workForgings and bar stock, pressure equipment, utility piping, structural welds
RTExposure set-up, film and digital imaging, image quality indicatorsCastings and welded pressure parts; the state licenses radiation use separately
ETCoil and probe types, impedance-plane interpretation, conductivity and crack checksHeat-exchanger tubing at generating stations, nonferrous component surfaces

Level 1 technicians perform set-ups and record readings under supervision. Level 2 technicians calibrate, interpret, apply the acceptance standard and sign results. Level 3 preparation focuses on the ASNT Basic and Method examinations and on writing procedures. See Level 1 courses, Level 2 courses and ASNT Level III preparation.

Ultrasonic testing (UT) training in Rochester, and MT for gears and shafts

Rochester's manufacturers handle a lot of forged and heat-treated steel: gear blanks, shafts, spindles and bar stock that must be free of internal defects before expensive machining begins. Ultrasonic testing is the method that finds those buried flaws, and it is also what utilities and contractors use for wall thickness on piping and vessels.

The UT course moves from wave behaviour and acoustic impedance to instrument calibration, straight-beam inspection of forgings and plate, thickness gauging and angle-beam weld examination. Students practise building distance-amplitude references and learn why the near field, beam spread and grain structure matter on heavy sections. Check yourself with the UT Level 2 practice questions.

Once a gear or shaft is ground and heat treated, the risk moves to the surface: grinding cracks, quench cracks and fatigue cracks at roots and fillets. Fluorescent magnetic particle inspection is the usual answer for steel parts, and penetrant for non-magnetic ones. Machinists heading for a quality role often take the MT course alongside UT, then the PT course.

For anyone aiming at outage work at Ginna, remember that nuclear in-service ultrasonic examination under ASME Section XI often requires performance demonstration qualification beyond SNT-TC-1A training, managed by the utility and its contractors.

Where NDT technicians work around Rochester

Nuclear power. Constellation's Ginna plant, a single-reactor station on the Lake Ontario shore in the town of Ontario, Wayne County, is one of the oldest operating reactors in the country, and Constellation has applied to extend its license. Refueling outages bring in-service inspection, component examination and heat-exchanger work, with the utility's quality and access programs on top of SNT-TC-1A.

Defense and space electronics. L3Harris builds communications and space systems in Rochester. Precision mechanical assemblies, housings and brackets for that kind of hardware are inspected under customer flow-down requirements, mainly with VT and PT.

Gears, machine tools and precision manufacturing. Gleason makes gear production machines and tooling in Rochester, and the region has a deep bench of machine shops, optics makers and contract manufacturers. Forgings, castings and finished parts are examined with UT, MT and PT before shipment.

Eastman Business Park. The former Kodak Park site now houses a mix of manufacturers, chemical and materials companies and utilities, with process piping, tanks and pressure equipment that need periodic examination.

Utilities, rail and infrastructure. Rochester Gas and Electric runs electric and gas networks across the region, CSX moves freight through the city, and NYSDOT and the New York State Canal Corporation maintain steel bridges, lift bridges and canal structures. Bridge welding follows AWS D1.5, and gas and pressure piping follow ASME and federal pipeline rules.

Job seekers searching "ndt jobs Rochester NY" will see quality-lab roles at manufacturers asking for MT, PT and VT, and field roles with inspection contractors asking for UT. Pay information from public sources is summarized in the NDT salary guide.

NDT schools and classes near Rochester: what to compare

Dedicated NDT programs are scarce in western New York, so a search for "ndt school near me" in Rochester mostly turns up welding programs, distant colleges and online courses. Each has a place.

  • Monroe Community College offers welding and fabrication courses, including an industry certificate with an evening and weekend option, through its workforce programs. They build welding skill and an eye for weld quality, though they are not NDT method courses.
  • Alfred State College, south of Rochester, runs welding technology programs, including one delivered in Buffalo, that cover codes and inspection practice. Again, welding rather than ASNT NDT certification.
  • Pennsylvania College of Technology in Williamsport offers a full associate degree in nondestructive testing, a long way from Rochester but one of the few such programs in the Northeast.
  • Employer programs at the utility, at large manufacturers and at inspection contractors train and certify staff under their own written practices.
  • Atlantis provides self-paced online theory with Level III support, simulator practice and practicals at the employer's workplace.

Ask the same things of every provider. Which method and level does the course cover, and does it match your employer's written practice? How many hands-on hours involve real equipment? Who grades the practical? Will you leave with a signed record of hours? Is the instructor a Level III in that method? Remember that a school cannot certify you under SNT-TC-1A; it can only train you.

Online NDT training in New York State

From Greece and Henrietta to Webster and Batavia, the theory portion can be completed online. Portal access starts as soon as you enroll, courses run all year, and you study at whatever pace your job allows, with a Level III to answer questions. People working second shift in a machine shop or rotating hours at the utility find that easier than fixed timetables.

Online theory satisfies formal training hours only; experience and the practical stay hands-on. More on the online NDT training page and in the training FAQ. You will find the published US fees in the table on this page; Register & Buy Now takes you to the course on the Atlantis portal.

Training a crew at your Rochester facility

Rochester manufacturers often discover their NDT program needs attention when a new customer audits them or when their only certified technician retires. Bringing a group of people up to level at once is more efficient than sending them away one by one.

  1. Look at the paperwork first. We review the written practice and procedures against the methods you use and the requirements your customers flow down, or help you draft them. See written practice development.
  2. Theory for everyone online, taken around production.
  3. Rehearsal in the simulator before the hands-on work.
  4. Practicals and examinations in person at your plant on your own equipment and parts, under an ASNT Level III.
  5. A complete certification file for each technician, ready for the next audit.

The course author and examiner is Anoop Rayavarapu, who holds ASNT NDT Level III certification in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT and brings more than eleven years of international field experience. Outside Level III support for audits and procedures is covered on the NDT Level III consulting page. Fabricators that also need a certified welding inspector can look at the six-day AWS CWI exam-prep course; AWS sets and administers that examination.

Radiography licensing in New York

As an NRC Agreement State, New York regulates radioactive material itself. Outside New York City, the State Department of Health licenses industrial use of radioactive material under Part 38 of Title 12 of the state's codes, known as Industrial Code Rule 38, and authorizes industrial radiography in a license of its own. The company holds that license, and each radiographer must document training and pass a written test on radiation safety, with certain third-party radiographer certifications accepted as evidence.

None of that is covered by an SNT-TC-1A RT course, which teaches technique and interpretation only. Crews coming from Pennsylvania or Ohio should confirm reciprocity before they bring a source into the state. Course details: radiographic testing training.

Practise before your practical exam

The Practical NDT simulator works in a browser and covers 12 method families across 12 virtual workplaces, including an NDT lab that suits Rochester candidates preparing for quality-lab roles and a heat exchanger workplace for utility work. Rehearse set-ups and interpretation there; real experience and the hands-on practical still come at the employer.

The NDT practice tests help you prepare for the written general and specific examinations.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Rochester

How long does NDT training take in Rochester, NY?

Online theory goes at your pace. Experience hours, set by your employer's written practice, take the longest, so reaching Level 2 is usually a matter of months.

How much does NDT training cost in Rochester?

Standard course fees are published in the table on this page, and onsite programs for a group are quoted when you contact us.

Is this page about Rochester, New York or Rochester, Minnesota?

Rochester, New York. The online theory and simulator are available from either city, but the employers and regulations described here are those of western New York.

Can I study NDT online in New York State?

Yes. Theory is fully online with Level III question support. The practical examination and experience hours happen in person with an employer.

Is there an NDT school near me in Rochester?

Local colleges teach welding rather than NDT methods, and the nearest full NDT degree is in Williamsport, Pennsylvania. Atlantis does not run a school in Rochester; its training is online, with practicals at the employer.

Which NDT method suits a machinist?

MT and PT first, because they are used constantly on finished parts, then UT for forgings and bar stock.

Where are the NDT jobs around Rochester?

Quality labs at manufacturers, the nuclear plant and its outage contractors, the utility, and inspection companies serving bridges and industrial plants.

Does an employer certification transfer to a new job?

No. A new employer reviews your records and certifies you under its own written practice; keep your training and experience logs complete to make that quick.

Can I prepare for ASNT Level III online?

Yes. See ASNT Level III training for self-paced preparation for the Basic and Method examinations.

Can you train technicians at our Monroe County plant?

Yes. Theory is online and the practicals and examinations take place in person at your plant under your written practice. Start from the training page; we reply within one business day.
